title: Red on the month and had no confidence I’ll bring it back
summary: It has been a horrible week I’m overall down on my account because I revenge traded and fell into my emotions like a loser and now I’m just so low on confidence despite having a proven strategy I think to myself “I would need to catch 4 wins in a row to bring back the losses” which messes with my head because I’m doubting myself I understand red weeks or months happen but the fact I broke my rules after telling myself I wouldn’t in 2026 just makes me feel so bad as a trader.submitted by/u/SnooDoggos5331[link][comments]
